title: IAMMAI v1 Witness Artifact Body
description: Canonical witness artifact body schema for v1. This schema defines the witness artifact as artifact only. It preserves bounded trace, explicit claims, and explicit non-claims without carrying execution, envelope, registry, preservation, or transport context as canonical body content.

witness_id.description: Artifact identity for the witness artifact body. This is not execution or envelope identity.

witness_type.description: Typed witness class preserved by the artifact body.

target_ref.description: Canonical reference to the matter, artifact, state, interaction, or occurrence relation the witness preserves.

observed_at.description: Time at which the witnessed contact or observation occurred.

claims.description: Bounded witness claims about preserved contact or occurrence.

non_claims.description: Explicit non-claims that keep witness trace bounded and prevent collapse into authorship, semantic source, authority, or governance force.

actor_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to the actor associated with the witnessed contact where actor relation is part of witness standing.

surface_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to the surface on which the witnessed contact occurred where surface relation is part of witness standing.

scope_ref.description: Optional bounded scope reference where scope relation is part of witness standing.

related_validation_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related validation artifact where that relation is preserved by the witness itself.

related_transition_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related transition record where that relation is preserved by the witness itself.

related_governance_action_ref.description: Optional canonical reference to a related governance action record where that relation is preserved by the witness itself.
